title: Fixing Distribution Shifts of LLM Self-Critique via On-Policy Self-Play Training
paper_type_zh: On-policy 自我批评与纠正训练配方
best_for_zh: 研究批评数据漂移、过程奖励、self-play buffer 与数学 RLVR 的读者
one_line: SCOP refreshes reasoning-critique-correction episodes from the current policy and scores critiques through sampled repair success, but its official repository remains an implementation-free placeholder.
SCOP 从当前策略刷新推理-批评-纠正 episode，并按采样修复成功率奖励批评，但官方仓库仍无实现与轨迹发布。
why: It makes critique-data freshness and stage-specific feedback explicit construction variables while exposing how teacher initialization, model-relative prompt filtering, Monte Carlo noise, and missing trajectory lineage limit reuse.
inclusion_reason: A concrete current-policy refresh recipe for complete reasoning-critique-correction episodes, with answer-level stage rewards, Monte Carlo critique scoring, explicit prompt filtering, and fully reported appendix hyperparameters.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The ACL 2025 paper targets a distribution mismatch in self-critique training. Static or iteratively synthesized critique data are generated from human-inserted errors, a teacher, or an earlier policy, but the trained model must critique errors from its current reasoning distribution. The paper's preliminary experiment shows models critique the previous round more effectively than their own current round, motivating a buffer refreshed by the policy being optimized. A second problem is reward hacking: final-answer supervision alone cannot distinguish a useful critique from hallucinated criticism followed by a lucky or failed correction. (Paper Sections 1 and 3, Figure 2.)

SCOP's data object is a branching mathematical self-play episode rather than an isolated critique. It joins a question and gold answer with current-policy reasoning, four critiques, eight corrections conditioned on each critique, extracted answers, a hallucination disposition, and stage-specific rewards. GSM8K and MATH plus Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct seed a 60K Pair-SFT initialization pool; cleaned Numina-CoT supplies later PPO prompts. The decision boundary is the construction of fresh feedback-bearing episodes, not a claim that self-critique is generally reliable or that outcome accuracy certifies process quality.

This belongs in the data-construction/open-release track because prompt filtering, teacher initialization, current-policy rollout refresh, reward attachment, and buffer lineage determine the training data. The official ACL paper and Appendices A-D provide L4 method evidence, but the paper-linked GitHub repository currently contains only MIT LICENSE and .gitignore. No dataset, trajectories, configs, checkpoints, or runnable implementation are released.

ACL 2025 论文处理自我批评训练中的分布不匹配。静态或迭代合成的批评数据来自人工插错、教师或早期策略，但训练后的模型必须批评当前推理分布中的错误。论文的预实验显示，模型批评上一轮推理往往比批评本轮自身推理更有效，因此需要由正在优化的策略刷新 buffer。另一问题是 reward hacking：只看最终答案的监督无法区分“有用批评”和“幻觉式批评后碰巧修对或仍修错”。（论文第 1、3 节与图 2。）

SCOP 的数据对象是分支式数学 self-play episode，而不是孤立批评。它把问题与金标准答案、当前策略推理、四条批评、每条批评条件下的八条纠正、抽取答案、幻觉判定和分阶段奖励连接起来。GSM8K、MATH 与 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 构成 60K Pair-SFT 初始化池，清洗后的 Numina-CoT 提供后续 PPO 提示。问题边界在于构造新鲜、携带反馈的 episode，并不等于自我批评普遍可靠，也不等于 outcome 准确率能认证过程质量。

本工作属于“数据构造与开放发布”轨道，因为提示过滤、教师初始化、当前策略 rollout 刷新、奖励附着位置与 buffer 谱系共同决定训练数据。ACL 正式论文和附录 A-D 提供了 L4 方法证据，但论文链接的 GitHub 仓库目前只有 MIT LICENSE 与 .gitignore，没有数据集、轨迹、配置、检查点或可运行实现。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SCOP first teaches one 7B policy to emit successive reasoning, critique, and correction segments, then regenerates those segments on-policy before PPO updates. Pair-SFT is teacher-dependent: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct rewrites reference solutions and annotates critiques/corrections for reasoning sampled from the initial policy. Post-validation retains an initialization item only if the annotator produces at least 6 correct corrections in 8 samples, producing the reported 60K examples. Thus “on-policy” describes the PPO refresh phase, not the full provenance chain. (Paper Section 4.1; Appendix B.2.)

The feedback contract attaches different signals to segment ends. A reasoning segment receives 1 when its extracted answer matches gold. For a critique, the policy samples n corrections and receives m/n + h(c), where m corrections are correct; the main setting uses n=8. A correct correction receives 1 + alpha, with alpha=1. Hallucination logic penalizes a critique that attacks correct reasoning or fails to flag wrong reasoning. The paper text defines h(c) as -1 or 0, whereas Appendix Table 8 and Table 10 select {-1, 1}; this unresolved specification difference matters for reproduction. (Paper Section 4.2; Appendix A.1 and B.3.)

The closest contrasts are Critic-CoT's iterative, earlier-policy critique synthesis and SCoRe/REFT's outcome-reward training. SCOP's specific change is to make reasoning, critique, and downstream repair samples come from the current policy and to score the critique through repair success. The Monte Carlo reward observes whether sampled corrections finish correctly, not whether the critique precisely identifies every faulty step, so it is process-positioned feedback rather than a process-correctness oracle.

SCOP 先通过 Pair-SFT 让一个 7B 策略连续生成推理、批评和纠正片段，再在 PPO 更新前以 on-policy 方式重新生成这些片段。Pair-SFT 仍依赖教师：Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 重写参考解答，并为初始策略采样的推理标注批评与纠正。只有教师在 8 次采样中至少给出 6 次正确纠正的初始化项才被保留，最终得到论文报告的 60K 样本。因此，“on-policy”描述 PPO 刷新阶段，而不是整个谱系链。（论文第 4.1 节；附录 B.2。）

反馈合同把不同信号附着在不同片段末端。推理片段的抽取答案匹配金标准时得 1 分。对一条批评，策略采样 n 条纠正并获得 m/n + h(c)，其中 m 条纠正正确；主设置 n=8。正确纠正获得 1 + alpha，且 alpha=1。幻觉规则会惩罚“攻击正确推理”或“没有指出错误推理”的批评。正文把 h(c) 定义为 -1 或 0，而附录表 8 与表 10 选择 {-1, 1}；这一未解决的规格差异会直接影响复现。（论文第 4.2 节；附录 A.1、B.3。）

最接近的对照是 Critic-CoT 的迭代式早期策略批评合成，以及 SCoRe/REFT 的 outcome-reward 训练。SCOP 的具体变化，是让推理、批评和下游修复样本来自当前策略，并用修复成功率评价批评。Monte Carlo 奖励能观察采样纠正是否最终正确，却不能判断批评是否精确定位每个错误步骤，因此它是附着在过程位置的反馈，而不是过程正确性 oracle。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reconstructable pipeline is:

  1. Reference and policy initialization. Use GSM8K and MATH training questions. Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct rewrites reference reasoning. Fine-tune DeepSeek-Math-7B-Base or Qwen2.5-7B-Base to produce reasoning, sample multiple paths, and label each path correct or incorrect from its final answer.
  2. Teacher critique synthesis. Give the annotator the question, policy reasoning, and reference solution. Generate critique/correction targets. Re-enter the incorrect reasoning plus critique and sample eight corrections; retain the item only when at least six corrections are correct. The paper reports 60K examples divided into correct-path D+ and incorrect-path D- for Pair-SFT.
  3. Pair-SFT. On D+, train the full reasoning-critique-correction sequence; on D-, train critique and correction conditioned on the supplied incorrect reasoning. Use mixture weight 1, batch 256, AdamW, cosine scheduling, warmup 0.03, five epochs, and learning rates 5e-5/1e-5 for DeepSeek/Qwen.
  4. RL prompt selection. Start from cleaned Numina-CoT after removing proof questions without standard numerical answers. For each prompt, sample eight answers from the initial policy and eight from the annotator. Remove prompts solved by the policy 8/8 times and prompts solved by the annotator 0/8 times; the surviving count is not reported.
  5. On-policy episode collection. The current policy generates reasoning, four critiques, and eight corrections per critique: 32 correction rollouts per reasoning episode. Sampling uses temperature 0.6, top-p 0.9, and at most 2,048 output tokens. Assign reasoning correctness, Monte Carlo critique reward plus hallucination adjustment, and correction correctness plus bonus.
  6. PPO and refresh. Optimize the summed stage rewards with PPO and KL penalty 0.05 against the frozen Pair-SFT policy, then sample the next buffer from the updated policy. PPO uses batch 1,024, policy/value learning rates 2e-6/5e-6, GAE lambda 0.95, gamma 1, and at most 1,500 steps. (Appendix Tables 9-10.)

Experiments run on Linux with 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs, PyTorch 2.4.0, verl, FSDP, FlashAttention-2, and vLLM; one complete RL run reportedly costs about 960 GPU-hours. A faithful build must additionally pin source revisions, prompt templates as executed, answer extraction/equivalence code, all failed samples, seeds, policy/value checkpoints, h(c) semantics, and buffer-round manifests. None is available in the official repository.

可重建流程如下：

  1. 参考解答与策略初始化。 使用 GSM8K 和 MATH 训练题。Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 重写参考推理；再微调 DeepSeek-Math-7B-Base 或 Qwen2.5-7B-Base 使其生成推理，采样多条路径，并按最终答案把路径标为正确或错误。
  2. 教师批评合成。 向教师提供问题、策略推理与参考解答，生成批评/纠正目标。随后把错误推理与批评重新作为上下文，采样八条纠正；至少六条正确时才保留。论文报告得到 60K 样本，按正确路径 D+ 和错误路径 D- 划分后用于 Pair-SFT。
  3. Pair-SFT。 在 D+ 上训练完整推理-批评-纠正序列；在 D- 上给定错误推理，训练批评与纠正。混合权重为 1，batch 256，AdamW，余弦日程，warmup 0.03，训练五轮；DeepSeek/Qwen 学习率分别为 5e-5/1e-5。
  4. RL 提示选择。 从清洗后的 Numina-CoT 开始，先移除没有标准数值答案的证明题。每条提示由初始策略和教师各采样八次；移除策略 8/8 全部答对的提示，以及教师 0/8 全部失败的提示。剩余数量未报告。
  5. On-policy episode 收集。 当前策略生成推理、四条批评，并为每条批评生成八条纠正，即每个推理 episode 有 32 条纠正 rollout。temperature 0.6、top-p 0.9、最大输出 2,048 tokens；分别赋予推理正确性奖励、Monte Carlo 批评奖励与幻觉调整、纠正正确性奖励与 bonus。
  6. PPO 与刷新。 用 PPO 最大化各阶段奖励之和，并相对冻结的 Pair-SFT 策略施加 0.05 的 KL 惩罚；更新后再从新策略采样下一轮 buffer。PPO 使用 batch 1,024，policy/value 学习率 2e-6/5e-6，GAE lambda 0.95、gamma 1，最多 1,500 步。（附录表 9-10。）

实验运行在 Linux、8 张 NVIDIA A100、PyTorch 2.4.0、verl、FSDP、FlashAttention-2 与 vLLM 上；一次完整 RL 训练约耗 960 GPU-hours。忠实构建还需固定来源版本、实际执行提示、答案抽取/等价判断代码、全部失败样本、随机种子、policy/value 检查点、h(c) 语义和 buffer 轮次清单；官方仓库均未提供。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Table 1 reports greedy Accuracy and BoN@16 on GSM8K, SVAMP, MATH-OAI, and OlympiadBench. With DeepSeek-Math-7B-Base, SCOP averages 68.78/83.97 versus 63.38/78.91 for Critic-CoT (Iter@3), a 5.40-point greedy difference. With Qwen2.5-7B-Base, SCOP averages 78.41/87.16 versus 74.75/84.35, a table-derived 3.66-point greedy difference; the main-results prose rounds this to 3.65. Critique self-consistency at inference raises SCOP to 69.34/84.19 and 79.06/87.58, respectively. These are author-reported downstream scores, not trajectory-quality labels.

Table 2 isolates correction behavior under greedy decoding. DeepSeek SCOP moves from Acc@R=53.2 to Acc@S=57.4, with 7.2% wrong-to-correct and 3.0% correct-to-wrong transitions. Qwen moves from 71.3 to 76.6, with 11.7% wrong-to-correct and 6.4% correct-to-wrong. Self-critique therefore repairs some failures while still damaging some initially correct answers.

The on/off-policy comparison in Figure 4 shows off-policy evaluation accuracy peaking and then declining, while on-policy accuracy continues toward convergence under the paper's simulation. Table 7 reports that removing reward shaping lowers average Accuracy from 68.78 to 64.22 for DeepSeek and from 78.41 to 73.23 for Qwen; replacing PPO with rejection fine-tuning lowers it to 63.48 and 72.45. This supports the combined training recipe but does not isolate whether critique-reward accuracy, buffer freshness, or another PPO interaction causes the gain.

Sampling cost is material. Table 6 reports 1,924,239 generated tokens per optimization step for SCOP with four critiques and eight corrections; reducing sampling to 1-by-1 lowers Qwen GSM8K/MATH-OAI from 93.1/60.4 to 87.8/50.3. Appendix Figure 6 finds the largest self-critique gains at middle MATH-OAI difficulty levels rather than the easiest or hardest. Together these results bound the claim: the tested recipe benefits current 7B policies under high sampling compute, but benchmark gains do not prove that critiques are faithful, rewards unbiased, data uncontaminated, or artifacts reproducible.

表 1 报告 GSM8K、SVAMP、MATH-OAI 与 OlympiadBench 上的 greedy Accuracy 和 BoN@16。以 DeepSeek-Math-7B-Base 为底座，SCOP 平均为 68.78/83.97，Critic-CoT (Iter@3) 为 63.38/78.91，greedy 差值 5.40。以 Qwen2.5-7B-Base 为底座，SCOP 为 78.41/87.16，对照为 74.75/84.35，由表计算 greedy 差值 3.66；正文将其写为 3.65。推理时使用批评 self-consistency 后，SCOP 分别升至 69.34/84.19 与 79.06/87.58。这些是作者报告的下游分数，不是轨迹质量标签。

表 2 用 greedy decoding 分离纠正行为。DeepSeek SCOP 从 Acc@R=53.2 变为 Acc@S=57.4，错误转正确为 7.2%，正确转错误为 3.0%；Qwen 从 71.3 变为 76.6，错误转正确为 11.7%，正确转错误为 6.4%。因此，自我批评能修复部分失败，也会破坏部分原本正确的答案。

图 4 的 on/off-policy 比较显示，在论文模拟中，off-policy 评估准确率先达峰后下降，而 on-policy 准确率继续提升直至收敛。表 7 中，去掉 reward shaping 后，DeepSeek 平均 Accuracy 从 68.78 降至 64.22，Qwen 从 78.41 降至 73.23；用拒绝采样微调替代 PPO 时又分别降至 63.48 与 72.45。这支持组合训练配方，但没有隔离增益究竟来自批评奖励准确性、buffer 新鲜度还是其他 PPO 交互。

采样成本不可忽略。表 6 报告四条批评、每条八次纠正时，SCOP 每个优化步生成 1,924,239 tokens；降为 1×1 后，Qwen 的 GSM8K/MATH-OAI 从 93.1/60.4 降至 87.8/50.3。附录图 6 显示，自我批评在 MATH-OAI 中等难度上的增益最大，而不是最易或最难题。由此可见，所测配方在高采样计算下有利于当前 7B 策略，但基准增益不能证明批评忠实、奖励无偏、数据无污染或制品可复现。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior self-critique recipes either synthesize critiques from injected or earlier-policy errors, train on a static teacher corpus, or apply outcome rewards to the final answer. Critic-CoT represents iterative critique-data synthesis; SCoRe and REFT represent outcome-supervised reinforcement learning. These baselines can improve correction but do not jointly ensure that the reasoning being criticized and the critic/corrector come from the current policy distribution.

SCOP's concrete change is a refreshed full-episode object plus stage-specific feedback. The same current policy produces reasoning, critique, and correction; multiple downstream repairs turn critique usefulness into a Monte Carlo reward; and a rule handles two obvious hallucination patterns. This makes data freshness, critique sampling, correction sampling, and reward placement independently auditable construction variables.

The work does not introduce a new mathematical truth source, remove teacher supervision, or validate critique steps. Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct still constructs and post-validates the Pair-SFT start, gold-answer matching remains the terminal oracle, PPO is existing machinery, and the RL prompt filter is model-relative. The paper's claim of avoiding synthetic data therefore applies at most to refreshed PPO rollouts, not to initialization.

For reasoning-data research, the useful direction signal is to compare policies trained on identical prompt and sampling budgets while varying buffer age and critique-feedback contract. Before reuse, builders should resolve h(c), quantify verifier false decisions, preserve failed branches, and test whether the middle-difficulty concentration and high correction budget are necessary across other model sizes and domains.

既有自我批评配方通常从人工插错或早期策略错误合成批评、在静态教师语料上训练，或只对最终答案施加 outcome reward。Critic-CoT 代表迭代批评数据合成，SCoRe 与 REFT 代表结果监督强化学习。它们可以改进纠正，却不能同时保证“被批评的推理”和“批评/纠正者”都来自当前策略分布。

SCOP 的具体变化是刷新完整 episode，并按阶段附着反馈。同一当前策略生成推理、批评与纠正；多条下游修复把批评有用性转成 Monte Carlo 奖励；规则再处理两类明显的批评幻觉。由此，数据新鲜度、批评采样数、纠正采样数与奖励位置成为可分别审计的构造变量。

本工作没有提供新的数学真值来源，没有消除教师监督，也没有验证批评步骤。Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 仍负责构造并后验验证 Pair-SFT 起点，金标准答案匹配仍是终局 oracle，PPO 是既有机制，RL 提示过滤也依赖模型。因此，论文“避免 synthetic data”的表述至多适用于刷新的 PPO rollout，而不适用于初始化。

对推理数据研究而言，有价值的方向信号是：在相同提示和采样预算下，仅改变 buffer 年龄与批评反馈合同来比较策略。复用前应解决 h(c) 规格、量化验证器误判、保留失败分支，并检验中等难度集中与高纠正预算在其他模型规模和领域是否仍有必要。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Teacher-dependent start: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct writes reference reasoning, critiques, and corrections and controls the 6-of-8 post-validation filter. On-policy refresh does not erase that initial style or selection bias.
  • Reward ambiguity: Section 4.2 defines h(c)=-1 for hallucination and 0 otherwise, while Appendix Table 8 and Table 10 use the selected set {-1, 1}. Without code, the implemented critique reward cannot be determined.
  • Conflated critique signal: m/n measures whether the current correction policy can act after a critique. A precise diagnosis can score poorly when repair is weak; a vague critique can score well when the answer is easy to repair.
  • Coarse verification: Final-answer matching does not prove intermediate reasoning or critique validity and may mishandle extraction or mathematical equivalence. The hallucination rule covers only obvious answer-correctness combinations, not subtle false criticism.
  • Model-relative filtering: Removing policy-8/8-correct and annotator-0/8-correct prompts creates a middle band tied to two checkpoint revisions. It excludes mastered behavior and questions beyond the annotator, limiting coverage and comparability.
  • Compute burden: Four critiques times eight corrections consumes about 1.92M generated tokens per optimization step, and a full run uses about 960 A100 GPU-hours. The authors also identify Monte Carlo scoring cost as a limitation.
  • Collapse and gaming risk: Sparse/noisy reward can cause policy collapse on problems without labeled solution processes. PPO may exploit answer extraction, the hallucination rule, or correction bonuses; no adversarial reward audit is reported.
  • Scope and attribution: Experiments cover two 7B models and mathematical/physics-style benchmarks. Larger models and other domains are untested, while gains combine teacher initialization, prompt filtering, on-policy refresh, reward shaping, and PPO.
  • Release failure: At verified HEAD 4a24ea4, the official repository contains only MIT LICENSE and .gitignore. Pair-SFT rows, Numina prompt manifests, rollouts, failed branches, rewards, prompts as files, configs, dependencies, and checkpoints are absent.
  • Audit gaps: Generated-asset licensing, source-version lineage, decontamination, evaluation overlap, seeds, and exact answer-verifier behavior remain unknown. The MIT repository license does not cover artifacts that were never released.
  • Reporting discrepancy: Table 1 yields a 3.66-point Qwen greedy advantage, whereas the prose reports 3.65. This is small but reinforces the need to cite table conditions rather than headline deltas.

• 依赖教师的起点： Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 编写参考推理、批评与纠正，并控制 6/8 后验验证。On-policy 刷新不会消除初始风格和选择偏差。
  • 奖励规格歧义： 第 4.2 节定义幻觉时 h(c)=-1、否则为 0，附录表 8 与表 10 却采用 {-1, 1}。没有代码时无法确认实际实现的批评奖励。
  • 批评信号混杂： m/n 衡量当前纠正策略能否根据批评完成修复。纠正能力弱时，精确诊断也可能低分；答案容易修复时，模糊批评也可能高分。
  • 验证粗糙： 最终答案匹配不能证明中间推理或批评有效，也可能误处理答案抽取与数学等价。幻觉规则只覆盖明显的答案正确性组合，不能识别细微的错误批评。
  • 依赖模型的过滤： 移除“策略 8/8 全对”和“教师 0/8 全错”的提示，会形成绑定两个检查点版本的中间难度带，排除已掌握行为和超出教师能力的问题，限制覆盖与可比性。
  • 计算负担： 四条批评乘八条纠正，每个优化步约生成 1.92M tokens；完整训练约用 960 A100 GPU-hours。作者也把 Monte Carlo 评分成本列为限制。
  • 崩溃与投机风险： 在没有标注解题过程的问题上，稀疏或噪声奖励可能导致 policy collapse。PPO 还可能利用答案抽取、幻觉规则或纠正 bonus；论文没有对奖励做对抗审计。
  • 范围与归因： 实验覆盖两个 7B 模型和数学/物理风格基准。更大模型与其他领域未测试，增益又混合了教师初始化、提示过滤、on-policy 刷新、reward shaping 与 PPO。
  • 发布失败： 经核验的 HEAD 4a24ea4 中，官方仓库只有 MIT LICENSE 与 .gitignore；Pair-SFT 记录、Numina 提示清单、rollout、失败分支、奖励、提示文件、配置、依赖和检查点均缺失。
  • 审计缺口： 生成制品许可、来源版本谱系、去污染、评估重叠、随机种子和答案验证器细节均为 unknown。MIT 仓库许可证不能覆盖从未发布的制品。
  • 报告差异： 表 1 得到 Qwen greedy 优势 3.66 分，正文写成 3.65。差异虽小，仍说明应引用带条件的表格，而不是只引用标题式增量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data-construction/open-release track, SCOP is a worked design for a current-policy, feedback-bearing buffer. Builders can use it to separate five modules: teacher-initialized Pair-SFT, model-relative prompt gating, current-policy episode collection, segment-specific reward calculation, and PPO refresh. A controlled study should hold prompts, rollouts, and optimizer budget fixed while changing only buffer age or critique reward.

An auditable implementation should serialize source dataset/revision and prompt ID; teacher and policy/value checkpoints; buffer round; reasoning and raw extracted answer; all four critiques; the hallucination decision and rule branch; all eight corrections per critique; normalized answers; verifier outputs; m/n, h(c), reasoning/correction rewards; sampling settings and seeds; PPO step; and acceptance/rejection reason. Failed and filtered prompts are necessary for measuring distribution shift rather than merely describing it.

The recipe can also seed verifier studies. Compare correction-success reward with step-error localization, human critique judgments, or calibrated learned critics; report how often a valid critique is unrepairable and how often an invalid critique precedes an easy repair. Audit correct-to-wrong transitions, prompt-band coverage, reward variance, extraction failures, policy collapse, and sensitivity to 4-by-8 sampling.

Reuse class: reading/audit reference only; direct training reuse is blocked. The paper and appendix are detailed enough to reimplement a hypothesis, but the official repository is not an implementation and no training object is released. Reuse requires code, immutable data/trajectory manifests, reward-spec reconciliation, checkpoint mapping, licenses, and contamination checks.

对“数据构造与开放发布”轨道而言，SCOP 是 current-policy、携带反馈的 buffer 设计实例。构建者可把它拆成五个模块：教师初始化 Pair-SFT、依赖模型的提示门控、当前策略 episode 收集、分片段奖励计算和 PPO 刷新。受控实验应固定提示、rollout 与优化预算，只改变 buffer 年龄或批评奖励。

可审计实现应序列化来源数据集/版本与提示 ID、教师及 policy/value 检查点、buffer 轮次、推理与原始抽取答案、四条批评、幻觉决策及规则分支、每条批评的八条纠正、归一化答案、验证器输出、m/n、h(c)、推理/纠正奖励、采样参数与种子、PPO 步数，以及接受/拒绝原因。失败与被过滤提示也是度量分布变化所必需的，不能只描述成功数据。

该配方还可作为 verifier 研究起点。可以把纠正成功奖励与步骤错误定位、人类批评判断或校准后的学习式 critic 比较；分别报告“有效批评但无法修复”和“无效批评后仍容易修复”的频率。还应审计正确转错误、提示难度带覆盖、奖励方差、抽取失败、policy collapse，以及对 4×8 采样的敏感性。

复用等级：仅作阅读/审计参考；当前不可直接训练复用。论文与附录足以重实现研究假设，但官方仓库不是实现，也没有发布训练对象。复用前需要代码、不可变数据/轨迹清单、奖励规格对齐、检查点映射、许可证与污染检查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Section 4.2 with Appendix A.1 and Table 10: h(c) is not specified consistently, so the critique reward cannot be reconstructed from prose alone.
  • Keep the two data phases separate: 60K teacher-generated/post-validated Pair-SFT examples initialize the policy; Numina-CoT prompts then produce on-policy PPO episodes.
  • Interpret 4 critiques times 8 corrections as 32 correction rollouts per reasoning episode, not as 32 independent source questions.
  • Read Table 2 as both benefit and failure evidence: wrong-to-correct transitions rise, but correct-to-wrong transitions remain 3.0% for DeepSeek and 6.4% for Qwen.
  • Treat GitHub commit 4a24ea4 as a placeholder release containing only a license and gitignore; do not infer code, data, checkpoints, or an implemented verifier.

• 联读第 4.2 节、附录 A.1 和表 10：h(c) 的规格不一致，不能只靠正文重建批评奖励。
  • 区分两个数据阶段：60K 条教师生成并后验验证的 Pair-SFT 样本初始化策略；Numina-CoT 提示随后产生 on-policy PPO episode。
  • 把 4 条批评乘 8 条纠正理解为每个推理 episode 的 32 条纠正 rollout，而不是 32 道独立源题。
  • 把表 2 同时视为收益与失败证据：错误转正确增加，但 DeepSeek 与 Qwen 的正确转错误仍分别为 3.0% 和 6.4%。
  • 把 GitHub commit 4a24ea4 视为只有许可证和 gitignore 的占位发布；不要据此推断存在代码、数据、检查点或已实现验证器。

items: Critique reward conflates diagnosis quality with the correction policy's capability and finite-sample variance.
Final-answer matching does not validate intermediate reasoning or critique claims and may be sensitive to extraction or equivalent-answer handling.
The hallucination rule is coarse, and the method prose uses h(c) in {-1,0} while Appendix Table 8 and Table 10 select {-1,1}.
Removing policy-always-correct and annotator-always-wrong prompts concentrates training on a model-dependent middle band and discards both mastered and very hard prompts.
Four-by-eight sampling costs about 1.92M generated tokens per optimization step; a complete RL run reports about 960 A100 GPU-hours.
On-policy freshness applies only after teacher-dependent Pair-SFT initialization; teacher style and errors remain in the starting policy.
Sparse or noisy rewards can still cause policy collapse, especially when labeled solution processes are absent.
Prompt manifests, raw/failed trajectories, verifier outputs, rewards, seeds, environment lockfiles, and checkpoints are unreleased.
Decontamination and overlap with GSM8K, SVAMP, MATH-OAI, OlympiadBench, and OCW evaluation data are unreported.
Table 1 implies a 3.66-point Qwen greedy gain, while the main-results prose reports 3.65; the Card uses table values.
批评奖励将诊断质量与纠正策略的能力及有限样本方差混在一起。
最终答案匹配不核验中间推理或批评主张，并可能对抽取或等价答案处理敏感。
幻觉规则粗糙，方法正文使用 h(c) in {-1,0}，而附录 Table 8 与 Table 10 选用 {-1,1}。
移除策略总是正确与标注者总是错误的提示，使训练集中于依赖模型的中间带，并丢弃已掌握与非常难的提示。
四乘八采样每个优化步约消耗 1.92M 生成 tokens；完整 RL 运行报告约 960 A100 GPU-hours。
On-policy 新鲜性仅在依赖教师模型的 Pair-SFT 初始化之后适用；教师模型风格与错误仍留在起始策略中。
稀疏或噪声奖励仍可导致策略崩溃，尤其在缺少已标注求解过程时。
提示清单、原始/失败轨迹、验证器输出、奖励、seeds、环境 lockfiles 与 checkpoints 未发布。
与 GSM8K、SVAMP、MATH-OAI、OlympiadBench 和 OCW 评测数据的去污染与重叠未报告。
Table 1 隐含 3.66 分的 Qwen greedy 增益，而主结果正文报告 3.65；本卡片采用表格数值。
